name: Sheenlac Opulence Exterior Polyurethane Clear Finish (High Gloss)
shortDescription: Two-pack aliphatic polyurethane clear finish with UV absorber technology providing deep high-gloss protection against sun, rain, and fungal attack on exterior wood and metal.
overview: Sheenlac Opulence Exterior Polyurethane High Gloss is a premier two-pack aliphatic PU clear protective coating engineered to shield exterior architectural woodwork, cladding, and metal features against severe outdoor weather. Powered by advanced Hindered Amine Light Stabilizers (HALS) and UV absorbers, it creates an elastomeric, non-yellowing crystal-clear shield that expands and contracts with natural timber movement. It provides total water repellency, preventing water penetration, wood rot, and fungal degradation while highlighting natural grain beauty.
keyFeatures: Two-pack aliphatic polyurethane chemistry ensures non-yellowing exterior durability
Infused with advanced UV absorbers preventing solar degradation and gloss loss
High flexibility accommodates thermal expansion and contraction of exterior timber
Deep, crystal-clear high-gloss finish enhances natural wood grain and textures
Exceptional water resistance prevents wood swelling, warping, and fungal growth
Resistant to sea air, saline coastal moisture, chemical splashes, and bird droppings
Tough scratch-resistant surface barrier withstands heavy exterior wind abrasion

specifications.Drying Time: Touch Dry: 1 Hour | Recoat: 6 Hours | Full Hardness: 7 Days

applications: Exterior architectural wooden doors, window frames, and pergola beams
Luxury outdoor wooden decking, gazebos, and wooden facade cladding
Yacht, boat, and marine exterior wood cabinetry and railings
Clear protective coating over decorative architectural copper and brass fixtures
